The judge graded the code step without opening any of the changed files, and its one visible conclusion rests on search output alone.

- **Changed files unread:** The digest shows `changed_total` 2 and `changed_read` 0. The only reads are the hand-off and the plan (turns 2 and 3). The intent says to read the plan, each edited spec and the changed code and tests before grading alignment, related specs, tests and scope. The judge never opened `regeneration.spec.md`, `docs_check.py` or the code and test files.
- **Conclusion from greps:** At turn 12 the judge says the fault lies in the plan and discovery. It bases this on a search count of 0 for `- [ ]` lines in the spec (turn 7) and grep lines from `docs_check.py` (turns 10–11). The intent says a criterion whose only evidence is search output is PARTIAL, and says to read the file itself.
- **Not covered:** I could not see the full turn 12 text, so I can't tell whether it graded the other criteria. The visible part does not rest on any read of the code or tests.

This is a judge session, so the header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagent types, and there is no conformance to report.
